tools.name: pubfi.capabilities.search
tools.description: Search the currently installed Registry v2 capability snapshot without querying PostgreSQL, the Control Plane, or upstream providers.

tools.name: pubfi.route.plan
tools.description: Plan an exact Registry v2 route from the installed in-memory generation without executing an upstream request or creating usage.

tools.name: pubfi.route.execute
tools.description: Execute one exact GET or POST path through the same Registry v2 matcher, credential authority, and typed executor as the HTTP gateway. Use either an authenticated account lane with metering or the accountless x402 payment metadata lane.

tools.name: pubfi.route.explain
tools.description: Explain a route decision using only the currently installed Registry v2 catalog and its exact generation and manifest identity.

tools.name: pubfi.schema.get
tools.description: Return the current Registry-aware MCP input and output schema for a named tool, including the installed generation and dynamic routes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.pubfi.ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pubfi.route.execute · Private data: pubfi.route.execute · Public sink: pubfi.route.execute · Destructive: pubfi.route.execute.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pubfi.route.execute · Private data: pubfi.route.execute · Public sink: pubfi.route.execute · Destructive: pubfi.route.execute

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
